user.title: Connect NOTTY
user.description: Enter your NOTTY account email address to receive a verification code.

code.title: Enter NOTTY code
code.description: Enter the verification code sent to {email}.

abort.already_configured: This NOTTY account is already configured.
abort.wrong_account: Sign in with the same NOTTY account as this integration.

litter_box_one_key.name: Litter box one-key action
litter_box_one_key.description: Run one of the NOTTY app one-key litter box actions.

litter_box_action.name: Litter box action
litter_box_action.description: Call a NOTTY litter box action or setting. Litter reminder interval changes are allowed for enabled reminders with a changed valid cycle; reset and trash-bag interval changes remain blocked.

litter_box_schedule.name: Litter box cleaning schedules
litter_box_schedule.description: List, create, update, enable, disable or delete NOTTY cleaning plans. Times use the NOTTY schedule clock (HH:MM), with no timezone conversion. Creating or enabling a plan may schedule cleaning; cleaning mode is left unchanged.

plan_id.name: Plan ID
plan_id.description: Required for update, enable, disable and delete. Obtain the exact ID with the list operation.

time.name: NOTTY schedule clock
time.description: Required for create and update. Use HH:MM as shown by the NOTTY schedule clock, without timezone conversion.
